metric.adjustedDesc: Average rank percentile across songs, factoring in the number of scores on the selected instrument so players with only a few scores do not rank too highly. Lower is better.
metric.weightedDesc: Rank percentile weighted by each song's leaderboard population, factoring in the number of scores on the selected instrument so players with only a few scores do not rank too highly. Lower is better.
metric.fcrateDesc: Full Combos divided by the total charted songs for the selected instrument. Unplayed charts remain in the denominator.
metric.totalscoreDesc: Sum of all scores across every played song.
metric.maxscoreDesc: Percentage of the maximum possible score achieved, factoring in the number of scores on the selected instrument so a few near-perfect scores do not rank too highly.

comboMetric.adjustedDesc: Song-count-weighted average of the adjusted percentile ratings from the instruments in this combo. Lower is better.
comboMetric.weightedDesc: Song-count-weighted average of the popularity-weighted percentile ratings from the instruments in this combo. Lower is better.
comboMetric.fcrateDesc: Full Combos divided by songs played across the instruments in this combo.
comboMetric.totalscoreDesc: Sum of eligible scores across the instruments in this combo.
comboMetric.maxscoreDesc: Average of the adjusted Max Score % ratings for the instruments represented in this combo.

familyMetric.adjustedDesc: Catalog-wide percentile across this instrument family. Unplayed charts contribute the worst percentile before the credibility adjustment. Lower is better.
familyMetric.weightedDesc: Catalog-wide popularity-weighted percentile across this instrument family. Unplayed charts contribute the worst percentile before the credibility adjustment. Lower is better.
familyMetric.fcrateDesc: Full Combos divided by every chart in this instrument family's catalog, including unplayed charts.
familyMetric.totalscoreDesc: Sum of eligible scores across this instrument family.
familyMetric.maxscoreDesc: Catalog-wide Max Score % across this instrument family. Unplayed charts contribute 0% before the credibility adjustment.

bandMetric.adjustedDesc: Average rank percentile across songs, factoring in chart coverage so bands with only a few scores do not rank too highly. Lower is better.
bandMetric.weightedDesc: Rank percentile weighted by each song's leaderboard population, factoring in chart coverage so bands with only a few scores do not rank too highly. Lower is better.
bandMetric.fcrateDesc: Percentage of played songs with a full combo, factoring in chart coverage so a short perfect streak does not rank too highly.
bandMetric.totalscoreDesc: Sum of all scores across every played song.
